records.title: FLRC: Fine-grained Low-Rank Compressor for Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: FLRC explicitly compresses LLM weights with fine-grained low-rank factors to enable deployment on resource-constrained hardware, directly addressing inference memory and efficiency.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Although large language models (LLM) have achieved remarkable performance, their enormous parameter counts hinder deployment on resource-constrained hardware. records.title: MobileMoE: Scaling On-Device Mixture of Experts
records.reason: MobileMoE investigates scaling sparse-expert language models for on-device deployment, directly engaging the memory and compute constraints of edge inference.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become the de facto architecture for hundred-billion-parameter language models, yet its advantages at sub-billion scales for on-device deployment remain largely unexplored. To close this gap, we present MobileMoE, a family of on-device MoE language models with sub-billion active parameters

records.title: MoE-Sched: Enabling Efficient FPGA Deployment of Mixture-of-Experts Vision Transformers via Coordinated Scheduling
records.reason: MoE-Sched coordinates scheduling, module reuse, chip mapping, and quantization for efficient FPGA deployment of MoE vision transformers; it is a concrete transformer inference accelerator contribution, though demonstrated on vision models.
